patāyati.p: [Pa+tanu+ya+te] (kamma,kri) Google Translate , ပ တာ ယ တေ၊ Patayante. ပ တာ ယ တိ၊ ပ ယာ ယန္ တိ၊ . ပ တ ညန္ တိ. R. 521 (Mag. 5.138).] Expanded.
a: ပတာယတိ(ကမ္မ၊ကြိ)
ကမ္မေ ကွစိ ဓာတူတိအာဒိနာ တနုဓုတွန္တဿ ယမှိ အာကာရော၊ ပတာယတေ၊ ပတာယန္တေ။ ပတာယတိ၊ ပတာယန္တိ၊ အာကာရာဘာဝေ ပတညတိ၊ ပတညန္တိ။ ရူ။၅၂၁။(မောဂ်၊၅။၁၃၈)။] ချဲ့-ဖြန့်-အပ်၏။

R:
paṭayati：ပဋယတိ （√ပဋ်）
ပြောဆို၏။ ရစ်ပတ်၏။

patāyati：ပ-တာယတိ （ကမ္မ） （ပ√တန်+ယ）
ချဲ့အပ်၏။
H: patāyati：擴大擴散（spread out），出（to be for sale?）．
B:
patāyati： patāyati（kamma，kri）
ပတာယတိ（ကမ္မ၊ကြိ）
[pa+tanu+ya+te．kamme kvaci dhātūtiādinā tanudhutvantassa yamhi ākāro，patāyate，patāyante．patāyati，patāyanti，ākārābhāve pataññati，pataññanti．rū．521．（，5．138）．]
[ပ+တနု+ယ+တေ။ ကမေ္မ ကွစိ ဓာတူတိအာဒိနာ တနုဓုတွန္တဿ ယမှိ အာကာရော၊ ပတာယတေ၊ ပတာယနေ္တ။ ပတာယတိ၊ ပတာယန္တိ၊ အာကာရာဘာဝေ ပတညတိ၊ ပတညန္တိ။ ရူ။၅၂၁။ （မောဂ်၊၅။၁၃၈）။]
P: Patāyati，[in form=pa+tāyati，diff．in meaning； not sufficiently expld，see Kern，Toev．p．29 s．v．It is probably a distorted *sphāṭayati：see under pharati，phalaka and phāteti] to be spread out，intrs．to spread （?） A．IV，97 （kodho p．，as if fr．pat）； J．III，283 （C．nikkhamati，as if fr．tṛ，Kern．trsls “to be for sale”）．（Page 405）

( a ) pātesuṃ, Ja IV 324, 16 ; Ps III 69, 8 ; Ap-a 504, 28 ; ( b ) pātayiṃsu, Th 252; Ja I 121, 21 ; Ps III 64, 8 ; ( c ) pātayuṃ, Mhv 5:31; 1 pl. pātayimhase, Ap 472, 28 (nisseṇiyā tam āruyha nisseṇiṃ ~ayimhase, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr pātapamhase); — absol. ( a ) pātetvā, Vin III 60, 28 (ambacorakā ambaṃ ~etvā); Ja I 164, 8 (sīsaṃ ~etvā); 444, 27 (taṃ pabbatapapātā ~etvā); II 201, 8 (bodhisattaṃ vijjhitvā ~etvā); VI 582, 18* ; Dhp-a II 74, 12 (therassa hatthaṃ udakaṃ ~etvā niyyādesi); Sp 853, 14 ; Mhv 26:18; — neg. apātetvā, Ps III 62, 20 ; It-a II 58, 4 ; ( b ) pātayitvā, Ja VI 308, 9* ; Ap 563, 13 ; Mil 109, 13 ; Mhv 23:59; ( c ) pātayitvāna, Ap 563, 7 ; Mhv 37:137; — ( d ) pātiya, Mhv 35:24 (dvāraṃ pātiya thāmasā); — pass. pr. 3 sg. pātiyati ( and patīyati ?), pātayati ?, is made or brought to fall; is thrown; is dropped; Pv 36:47 (avaṃsirā samaṇā pātayanti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pāṭiyanti); Ja VI 114, 32* (pāde gahetvā kissa ime pun’ eke avaṃsirā narake ~ayanti, eds so; cf 115, 17´ : te nirayapālā uddhapāde katvā tattha khipanti); 115, 14* (te ’me janā avaṃsirā narake ~ayanti); Mil 187, 30 (yathā mahārāja paṭhaviyā khalito patīyati evaṃ jinasāsanavare khalito paṇāmīyati, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se patati); — part.pr. pātiyamāna, mfn. , Ja VI 115, 18´ ; Sp 843, 25 ; Dhp-a III 153, 15 (māluvāya sambhañjitvā bhūmiyaṃ ~amāno rukkho); — pp pātita , mfn. , made to fall; brought down; thrown; dropped; Vin I 299, 26 (~e kuse); IV 175, 18 (khamāh’ ayye mayā si ~ā ti); Dhp 407 (yassa rāgo … makkho ca ~o sāsapo-r-iva āraggā); Ja I 120, 30 (sukkhadaṇḍakā ca sākhā ca palāsaṃ ca vātena ~aṃ hoti, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se patitaṃ); IV 195, 4* (~o giriduggasmiṃ); 388, 17 (tayā nadiyā dantakaṭṭhaṃ ~an ti); Nidd I 47, 27 (taṇhāya ~aṃ); Ap 280, 16 (sīhena ~o); Vism 63, 21 (vātena haritvā dūre ~aṃ); Pv-a 31, 29 (tayā imissā gabbho ~o ti); — neg. apātita, mfn. , Vin I 299, 24 ; Sp 758, 31 (apātitattā); — fpp pātetabba, mfn. , Vin III 82, 24 (na ca bhikkhave attānaṃ pātetabbaṃ, yo pāteyya āpatti dukkaṭassā ti); Ja II 51, 6 ; Sp 1124, 4 (cīvarapaṭiviṃsesu kuso pātetabbo); ( b ) pātabba 2 , mfn. ,? Sp 288, 29 (pacchimā janatā mā pāṇe pātabbe ghaṃsitabbe eva maññī ti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pātabye); — caus. pr. 3 sg. ( b ) pātāpeti , makes (someone) cause (something or someone) to fall; makes (someone) throw down or drop; Vin III 51, 33 (patitaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ gahessāmī ti ~eti); Ja II 88, 10 (adhunā āgato dhanuggaho … taṃ [ambapiṇḍiṃ] ~ethā ti); 435, 28´ (bhattabhājanaṃ ~etuṃ); III 370, 18 (khādāpeti c’ eva ~eti ca); Sp 460, 14 (sayaṃ pāteti aññena ~eti); 468, 19 (~ehī ti); Sv 134, 16 (gabbhaṃ ~etukāmā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pātetu-); — part.pr. pātāpenta, mfn. , Sp 349, 14 ; — aor. 3 sg. pātāpesi, Mp I 423, 25 ; — absol. pātāpetvā, Vin II 108, 35 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū taruṇaṃ yeva ambaṃ ~etvā paribhuñjiṃsu); Ja III 2, 8 (taṃ sākhaṃ … dārakeh’ eva ~etvā maddāpetvā); Sp 373, 11 ; — see also pattakkhandha ( sv patta 1 ).
